name: Animal Friendship
description:
General

Choose a non-humanoid creature within short range. You and the creature must be able to see and hear each other. If the creature's WITS score is 4 or higher, the spell has no effect.

Otherwise, roll Persuade vs Insight. On a win, for the next day, the creature is convinced that you mean it no harm. No effect on a loss.

If you or an ally attack the creature, the spell ends.
